object_level_recovery.artifact_state: complete, with r2, oci and github replicas all recorded verified

github.message: GitHub 副本收据不属于配置的 Vault

github_failure_assessment.explanation: The stored GitHub receipt was written against the previous vault repository, which no longer exists. SOCIAL_ARCHIVE_GITHUB_ARCHIVE_REPOSITORY now points at the freshly created LinzeColin/Social-Archive-Vault, so the receipt no longer belongs to the configured vault and restore_object.py refuses it. This is the fail-closed guard behaving correctly; a recovery must never trust a receipt from an unconfigured repository.
github_failure_assessment.consequence: The third ciphertext copy must be re-established under the new vault before a true three-target recovery can be claimed. That is blocked by the same single root cause as SA-503.

degrade_boundary_observed.what: restore_object.py refused artifact art_13c9f07eb26b6fbbd678cfd597fe0f36 with RECOVERY_RECEIPT_INVALID, 恢复对象不是完成态.
degrade_boundary_observed.assessment: Correct. That artifact is status=staged, and recovery is defined only over completed-state artifacts with verified receipts.

what_this_proves: The Private-Database cold backup writes two verified remote copies and two verified recovery descriptors, and both are independently restorable to the same plaintext hash.
Object-level recovery works for real from two of the three targets, producing byte-identical ciphertext and plaintext.
The recovery path fails closed rather than silently accepting a receipt from an unconfigured repository or a non-completed artifact.
what_this_does_not_prove: SA-506 closure. A true three-target recovery is not demonstrated, because the GitHub third copy is unavailable.
The rollback rehearsal half of SA-506.
Any degrade drill involving a deliberately failed destination.
non_actions: No production runtime, SQLite, CAS, secret or user content was modified. All restores wrote to isolated temporary targets that were removed afterwards.
No secret value was printed to terminal, transcript, evidence or Git.
No timer was enabled, no tag or release created, nothing pushed to origin.
